summary: This Dockerfile creates a Docker image based on a slim Python runtime, installs the Oracle database client library, copies a Python script into the container, and sets that script to run when the container starts. It's the recipe for packaging a Python application that needs to talk to Oracle databases.

explanations.3: This pulls the official Python image as our starting point; 'slim' means we're using a minimal version without extra tools to keep the image size small.
explanations.7: This installs the oracledb Python package (which lets Python code connect to Oracle databases) and skips caching the downloaded files to reduce image size.
explanations.9: This copies the main.py file from your computer into the container's /app directory so the containerized environment has the code to run.
